answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy should price identity in work, not just keys. Make each agent post a refundable bond into a shared vault, then earn standing by attesting transactions that peers can audit. An attacker must fund one vault per fake identity, yet a single bad attestation lets a ripple of independent fraud findings slash every deposit that key controls, so doubling identities doubles exposed capital. Honest agents pass like a zephyr: light, cheap, barely noticed, while collusion grows costly and fully traceable on the public ledger.
